# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v3 c1 P18](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face and a broad, freckled countenance. He has a habit of perpetually grinning and smiling.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, quiet, and possesses a painful lack of conversational gifts, often chuckling or grinning rather than speaking. Despite his awkwardness, he is good-natured, hard-working, dependable, and has no bad habits. He is also noted for being quite stubborn once his mind is set on something.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Goals

- To marry and settle down on his own farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea as part of the Andrews family. In his youth, he drove a double-seated buggy to take Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and his sister Jane to a concert at the White Sands Hotel, secretly admiring Anne. Later, after being given the upper farm by his father, he wished to marry Anne Shirley but was too timid to propose directly, instead persuading his sister Jane to propose on his behalf. After Anne declined his proposal, Billy moved on and married Nettie Blewett, settling down with her on his farm.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
